none: PAS SUSS-421203: Copper Alloy As of Domitian
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP C]AES DOM[ITIAN AVG GERM COS] [...]

A copper alloy Roman Dupondius of Domitian (81-96 AD). Mint: Rome. Reece Period 4. The coin is badly worn, but seems to depict a laureate bust facing right; it is likely that the obverse legend reads: [IMP C]AES DOM[ITIAN AVG GERM COS] [...]. It is uncertain whether the bust is dressed with the aegis or other drapery. Reverse type: FORTVNAE AVGVSTI, depicting Fortune seated or standing left,…
